title.en: Confidence, the Cabinet and the Opposition
title.fr: La confiance, le Cabinet et l'opposition

text.en: When the House of Commons votes on a big issue, such as the budget, the vote is treated as a matter of confidence.
text.fr: Quand la Chambre des communes vote sur une question importante, comme le budget, ce vote est considéré comme une question de confiance.

source.quote: When the House of Commons votes on a major issue such as the budget, this is considered a matter of confidence.

verification.evidence: When the House of Commons votes on a major issue such as the budget, this is considered a matter of confidence.

text.en: The Prime Minister and the ministers together form the Cabinet. The Cabinet makes important decisions about how Canada is governed.
text.fr: Le premier ministre et les ministres forment ensemble le Cabinet. Le Cabinet prend des décisions importantes sur la façon dont le Canada est gouverné.

source.quote: The Prime Minister and the Cabinet ministers are called the Cabinet and they make important decisions about how the country is governed.

verification.evidence: The Prime Minister and the Cabinet ministers are called the Cabinet and they make important decisions about how the country is governed.

text.en: The Cabinet prepares the budget and puts forward most new laws.
text.fr: Le Cabinet prépare le budget et propose la plupart des nouvelles lois.

source.quote: They prepare the budget and propose most new laws.

verification.evidence: The Prime Minister and the Cabinet ministers are called the Cabinet and they make important decisions about how the country is governed. They prepare the budget and propose most new laws.

text.en: Of the opposition parties, the one with the most members in the House of Commons is called the Official Opposition.
text.fr: Parmi les partis de l'opposition, celui qui compte le plus de députés à la Chambre des communes s'appelle l'opposition officielle.

source.quote: The opposition party with the most members of the House of Commons is the Official Opposition

verification.evidence: The opposition party with the most members of the House of Commons is the Official Opposition

text.en: Opposition parties have a job: to oppose the government's proposals peacefully, or to try to make them better.
text.fr: Les partis de l'opposition ont un rôle : s'opposer pacifiquement aux propositions du gouvernement, ou essayer de les améliorer.

source.quote: The role of opposition parties is to peacefully oppose or try to improve government proposals.

verification.evidence: The role of opposition parties is to peacefully oppose or try to improve government proposals.
